The '''R-4 recon droid''' was a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It was used mostly during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksmen]] and [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] R-4 [[Scout/Legends|recon]] droids<ref name="BF I guide" /> were equipped with a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] for propulsion and was armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In addition to this, these units were also equipped with an internal [[orbital strike beacon]] that could be activated remotely by the droid's owner. This beacon could call upon a small [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital strike]] from any ally [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in orbit. The device required a few seconds to power up, but the [[Probe droid/Legends|R-4]] was completely mobile even when it was activated, allowing it to evade incoming blaster shots from enemies during the time it is activated.<ref name="BF I" />

The R-4 recon droid was identical to the [[R-1 recon droid]], as well as the [[Mark IV recon droid]],<ref name="BF I" /> reconnaissance droids also produced by Arakyd Industries during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="BF I guide" /> The earlier R-1's design was similar to that of a [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] design.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the R-4 recon droid was used for battlefield reconnaissance and orbital strike spotting.<ref name="BF I guide" /> The R-4 was used by both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Marksmen]] on numerous battlefronts.<ref name="BF I" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', the sniper class is equipped with a remotely controllable [[Probe droid|recon droid]], which is capable of [[blaster cannon/Legends|blaster fire]] and calling down an [[Orbital bombardment|orbital strike]] on its position.

Although each faction's recon droid is functionally and aesthetically identical, they are classified as different models according to ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide]]''. Whereas the [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooter]] carries the Arakyd [[R-1 recon droid]] and the [[Battle droid assassin|assassin droid]] carries the [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[Mark IV recon droid]], the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] and [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel marksman]] are outfitted with the Arakyd [[R-4 recon droid]]. The recon droid returns in the sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' (2005), as a part of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|clone commander]], [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuard]], and [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]'s arsenal instead, but ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' designates them all as the Arakyd Mark IV recon droid.
